raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.9.0"
  build_number: 0
  openjdk: ${{ openjdk }}
  openjdk_next: ${{ openjdk|int + 1 }}

package:
  name: pyjnius
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/kivy/pyjnius/archive/${{ version }}.zip
  sha256: da8aad44c6deb33e8479a19cc98d9eca34e14fb98c3be0d7658b34b9c8dd748a

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}jdk${{ openjdk | version_to_buildstring or "latest" }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script:
    file: build
    # this is a work-around for something rattler-build should be doing,
    # see https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2587
    env:
      openjdk: ${{ openjdk }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: linux
      then:
        - make
        - sed
  host:
    - openjdk
    - python
    - cython >=3.1.2
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - ant
  run:
    - openjdk >=${{ openjdk }},<${{ openjdk_next }}
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - jnius
        - jnius.env
        - jnius_config
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    files:
      source:
        - .github/scripts/
        # created in source directory by ant (cf. build.sh / build.bat)
        - build/test-classes
        - tests/
      recipe:
        - test_pyjnius.py
    script:
        - python test_pyjnius.py
        # adapt CLASSPATH to pick up test classes
        - if: unix
          then: export CLASSPATH="$CLASSPATH:./build/test-classes"
          else: set "CLASSPATH=%CLASSPATH%;build/test-classes"
        - pytest -v tests/ -k "not test_cli_reports_mismatch"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/kivy/pyjnius
  repository: https://github.com/kivy/pyjnius
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Python module to access Java classes as Python classes using JNI (shared memory)

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - KeyWeeUsr
    - h-vetinari
